visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a light blue denim shirt and gray trousers walks toward the camera on a rooftop terrace with wooden flooring and a brick wall background. He is joined by another man in a green and yellow striped long-sleeved shirt holding a clear glass. (2) A woman with long dark hair, wearing an olive green fleece jacket, enters the frame from the left and engages in a lively, expressive conversation with the two men, gesturing with her hands. The scene is shot with a handheld camera, creating a dynamic, informal vlog style. (3) The scene shifts to an indoor bathroom with white tiled walls. The man in the denim shirt stands behind the woman, who is now wearing a black turtleneck, and applies a liquid product from a dark green bottle labeled 'AROMASE' directly onto her scalp. (4) Close-up shots show the man's hands massaging the product into her hair, creating a white lather. The woman smiles and gives a thumbs-up. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, showing the woman's hair 'Before' and 'After' the treatment, highlighting increased volume. (6) The man in the denim shirt returns to the rooftop, holding the green bottle and speaking directly into the camera, demonstrating the product's use on himself and sniffing the bottle.
